title: Activation lane: Microwalk asset pack & accessible empty-state photography
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a discrete asset pack for the Console first-run microwalk (Activation Lane) that covers: 1) hero screenshots for the tour at 3 breakpoints, 2) accessible empty-state photography set (6 variants), 3) microcopy alternatives with i18n-ready keys, and 4) a handoff-ready Figma file plus exported PNG/SVG assets. This ticket scopes visual design + microcopy + alt-text and does not include instrumentation or frontend integration (ENG owns event wiring). Deliverables should be retina-ready and optimized for low-latency loading in the console.

Why: Previous onboarding assets were designer-heavy SVGs that looked great but failed accessibility contrast tests and lacked photographic empty states for enterprise customers. This pack aims for higher perceived trust (photography), clearer progressive disclosure, and explicit alt text for screen readers.

Success criteria: exported Figma frames with correct naming, 2x and 3x PNG exports for hero screenshots, optimized SVGs for icons, six empty-state photos with licensing docs, localized microcopy variants (EN/FR/DE), and a documented handoff checklist in Confluence.

Non-goals: motion prototypes beyond simple Lottie placeholders, analytics/event schema (tracked in ENG-4210), and localization QA beyond copy variants prepared for translation.
comments: 2025-01-16 - Maya Chen: Kickoff meeting with PM and ENG. Agreed scope and deliverables. Noted constraint: keep hero screenshots under 250kb where possible to avoid slowing down first-run experience.
2025-01-21 - Luca Moretti: Initial wireframes uploaded to Figma. Focused on single-column mobile-first layout for the microwalk steps.
2025-01-29 - Evan Park (PM): Requested photography set to include at least one analog/office scene to support enterprise landing pages.
2025-02-03 - Accessibility review (Riley O'Neil): Contrast issues found on secondary CTA—revised color token and updated icon stroke weight per a11y guidelines.
2025-02-08 - Design review: Presented microcopy variants; product preferred shorter CTA copy for step 2. Need legal review for photography licensing before final export.
2025-02-12 - Luca Moretti: Updated Figma file with finalized frames and prepared export slices; started generating PNG/SVG exports for handoff.
review_feedback: Evan Park (PM) - prefer concise CTAs, suggested 'Get started' over 'Complete setup for your team' for step 2.
Riley O'Neil (Accessibility) - alt text needs to describe intent not just visuals; provided examples for each photo.
Janelle Ortiz (Design Lead) - prefer neutral palette for empty states; flagged one photo as too vibrant and requested desaturation.
Dev feedback (ENG-4210) - requested exports follow existing CSS token names for color and spacing to simplify implementation.
Legal - photo license okay with attribution file, but need source metadata embedded in exports.
decisions: Use photographic empty states instead of vector-only placeholders for enterprise trust signals.
Adopt a single color token for primary CTA across tour steps to meet contrast targets.
Keep microcopy terse (<= 45 characters) for step CTAs to avoid truncation on narrow viewports.
Provide explicit alt text examples in the asset pack for each image.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with annotated frames and component tokens published to team library.
PNG exports for hero screens at 2x and 3x and SVG exports for icons.
Six empty-state photographs with embedded metadata and an accompanying attribution text file.
Microcopy CSV with key, EN/FR/DE variants, and suggested alt text for each asset.
Confluence handoff checklist completed and linked in ticket.
qa_tasks: Verify exported images load under 250kb on staging console pages.
Run Lighthouse accessibility audit on the tour pages with exported assets.
Confirm localized microcopy fits UI across breakpoints.
Cross-check token names with ENG implementation branch (ENG-4210).
